upstreamChange.note: Retains PPTX chart data workbooks through GrabBag on load and reexport on save. The change itself records the remaining chart-data-update issue; retention is not proof of intentional-edit correctness.

inputs.corpus: path to the retained corpus inputs directory, supplied explicitly at run time
inputs.saved: path to the saved artifacts under test, supplied explicitly at run time

cases.note: The two charts carry distinct intentional edits. Charts renumber on save (chart2/chart3 -> chart1/chart2) and keep identical caches, so a chart is identified by slide plus the ordinal of its c:chart node, never by part name or cache.

The strict raw format difference is reported separately. Equivalence is only claimed for pure escaping/quoting changes; fill, spacing, symbol, precision, grouping, sign, value and formula changes are rejected.
